display.title: Episode 356: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 1 (Shabbos Chazak)
display.summary_short: The one time we shout in shul: Chazak, chazak, v'nischazek! Plus the start of The Return of Yehudah and the very first thing to do when you wake up: Shivisi Hashem.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Parshas Vayechi 5749. Uncle Yossi explains that a shul is Hashem's house, where we never shout, except this Shabbos: when the last sedra of Chumash Bereishis is finished, everyone calls out 'Chazak, chazak, v'nischazek' to ask Hashem for strength to learn more Torah, and the children practice it together. After the Hakochainik march, a yeshiva student leads the Shema in Studio 604. Story time begins a new serial, The Return of Yehudah: Reb Moshe and Sarah, a poor couple in a Polish town famous for their hachnasas orchim, are finally blessed with a son, Yehudah. Then their kind landlord sells the house to a cruel poritz who doubles the rent; Sarah tells her husband that Hashem is testing them. Next, a riddle: what comes even before Modeh Ani? The Shulchan Aruch says to first think before Whom we are lying, Shivisi Hashem l'negdi samid. A third-grade girls' class sings a Shiviti song, and children are invited to make their own Shiviti sign for their bedroom and write in about it.
display.lesson: When you wake up, first remember that Hashem is right there with you, and ask Hashem for strength to learn more Torah.
